meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你规划、配置、检查、重启和分析 FluidSim 模拟:选求解器、调参数、设 FFT/MPI、查输出、判断重启兼容,并给出带数值有效性和 HPC 安全校核的代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 FluidSim 求解器选择、参数检查、FFT/MPI 配置等,或想运行 2D/3D Navier-Stokes、浅水、层化流模拟时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置一个 2D Navier-Stokes 模拟,256×256 网格
say.note: 会生成参数设置和运行脚本

say.text: 这个旧模拟结果能接着重启吗?
say.note: 会检查文件并给出重启方案

say.text: 怎么在 fluidsim 里启用 FFT 和 MPI?
say.note: 会给出安装与并行运行命令

howto.what_en: Helps plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations: solver selection, parameter tuning, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, and restart compatibility, with numerical-validity and HPC safety checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, etc., or want to run fluid dynamics simulations like 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flows.

say_en.text: Set up a 2D Navier-Stokes simulation with a 256×256 grid.
say_en.note: Generates parameter config and run script.

say_en.text: Can this old simulation be restarted?
say_en.note: Checks files and gives restart plan.

say_en.text: How do I enable FFT and MPI in fluidsim?
say_en.note: Shows install and parallel run commands.
